title: Derivatives: How AI Learns From Mistakes - Retention Edit v2

voiceover.voice_name: Zara - Soft and Serene Indian Voice
voiceover.text: AI learns from mistakes. Like a missed shot, the error shows which way to adjust. In AI, the model predicts, checks the correct answer, and measures error. A derivative is the slope of that error. It points toward lower error. AI takes a small step, checks again, and repeats. Remember: derivative tells AI which way to adjust.

learning_design.primary_goal: Students remember that derivative means direction for reducing error.
learning_design.takeaway: Derivative tells AI which way to adjust.
learning_design.style: retention over flash; motion guides attention only
